name: @gleator/tidewater-lazaret
description: The Lazaret deployment that protects Tidewater Support.

scripts.predev: for d in . ../demo-origin; do [ -f $d/.dev.vars ] || cp $d/.dev.vars.example $d/.dev.vars; done && wrangler d1 migrations apply tidewater --local -c ../demo-origin/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
